question: Will the one-month change in U.S. advance retail and food services sales (Census, seasonally adjusted; computed from the level) for November 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-11-14) be above 0.30%, its value for August 2025?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2025-10-15 (August 2025), rounded as shown
